[-1.5 TO 1.5]
Risky, can go either way. If process is a differentiator, aim to progressively reduce to Enabler
levels. For hygiene processes, urgently reduce to Low Ease levels. For unimportant process;
no immediate change, monitor to ensure consistency. Use Physical, Time, Cognitive break
up for prioritization.
Inert
[1.5 TO 4]
If process unimportant explore options to eliminate or move to INERT levels. If process is
hygiene reduce to Low Ease levels immediately . If process is a differentiator, 90 day plan to
reduce to Enabler levels. Use Physical, Time, Cognitive break up for prioritization
Strenuous
